While this sequence favors Lilian Mermin Feinsilver's (1970/1980, pp. 229–230) mazuma + moola blend proposal—or Michael Quinion's (2007) treatment of mazoola as a mazuma variant—over a reverse clipping from mazoola to moolah, chronology alone does not prove either word-formation mechanism.
